title: Fuchsia Symphony: Couture Twinning
season: 1st Runway Showcase • KPR College of Arts Science and Research
imageAlts: Fuchsia Symphony Couture Twinning Ensemble on Runway by Praweena NS
description: A coordinated couture duo ensemble exploring silhouette scaling across generations—pairing a sheer beaded-stripe magenta bodice and voluminous multi-tiered tulle skirt with a miniature ruffled frock accented by metallic peplum detailing.
objective: Translate adult couture proportions into a cohesive child-and-adult runway pairing while maintaining stage movement and structural lightness.
inspiration: The rhythm of parallel silhouettes and celebratory South Indian festive vibrancy rendered in modern Western tulle.

title: Blush Petals & Hand-Tufted Pompoms
season: 2nd Runway Showcase • KPR College of Arts Science and Research
imageAlts: Blush Petals & Hand-Tufted Pompoms Runway Ensemble by Praweena NS
description: A romantic peach-pink sheer organza two-piece ensemble featuring bishop sleeves with flared bell cuffs, a pleated sweetheart bodice with gold zari neckline embroidery, 3D lavender floral appliqués, and hand-tufted crimson berry pom-poms scattered across the flowing skirt.
objective: Balance translucent volume and delicate pastel organza with bold, three-dimensional surface ornamentation that reads clearly under runway lighting.
inspiration: Botanical blossoms in full bloom—contrasting airy translucent petals against tactile, jewel-toned berry accents.

title: Celestial & Avant-Garde Ensemble
imageAlts: Four-look Celestial & Avant-Garde Runway Collection with Sunburst Millinery and Lotus Staff by Praweena NS
description: A four-look theme-based runway collection uniting sculptural womenswear and contemporary menswear—featuring geometric diamond-petal tailoring with a sunburst wire headpiece, a powder-blue cascading ruffle asymmetric jacket, an iridescent winged gown, and a metallic lattice-cutout ensemble with a sculptural lotus staff.
objective: Execute a cohesive four-model narrative theme combining architectural pattern-making, iridescent textile manipulation, and custom runway millinery/props.
inspiration: Celestial geometry, mythical archetypes, and sculptural contrast between rigid origami-like pleats and fluid holographic surfaces.
techniques: Custom Wire Millinery & Runway Prop Fabrication
